charts.title: LHS 1140 b: orbits around LHS 1140
charts.description: The orbits of LHS 1140's planets in this map from above, to scale, with LHS 1140 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Edwards et al. 2021 (2021AJ....161...44E), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EDWARDS_ET_AL_2021): P 24.7369148 d

charts.title: LHS 1140 b: its transit
charts.description: LHS 1140 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (3, 30) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 92226327, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 9-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
